name: Pleasant Shops
summary: Pleasant Shops is a grocery-anchored neighborhood shopping center serving South Weymouth and the greater South Shore region, located 15 miles south of Boston along the Route 18 corridor. With 23 retail spaces and convenient access to commuter rail, the center serves as a community hub adjacent to South Shore Hospital and near the transformative Southfield development.
demographics: Pleasant Shops serves the South Shore region of the Boston Metropolitan Area, drawing primarily from South Weymouth and surrounding communities located 15 miles south of downtown Boston. The trade area benefits from proximity to South Shore Hospital, the region's largest employer serving 725,000 people, attracting a mix of healthcare professionals, families, and middle to upper-middle income households. The center's location near the commuter rail station and the $1 billion Southfield mixed-use development by Starwood indicates a growing, transit-oriented demographic with both established residents and young professionals seeking convenient neighborhood shopping options.
description: Pleasant Shops is a dominant neighborhood grocery-anchored shopping center strategically positioned along the Route 18 corridor in South Weymouth, Massachusetts, serving as a vital community gathering place for the South Shore region. Located just 15 miles south of downtown Boston, this well-established center benefits from its prime location directly adjacent to South Shore Hospital, the area's largest employer serving 725,000 residents across Massachusetts. The center's accessibility is enhanced by its proximity to a commuter rail station and its position less than one mile from Southfield, Starwood's ambitious $1 billion mixed-use development that is transforming the area. With 23 retail spaces and a thoughtfully designed site plan, Pleasant Shops offers residents convenient access to essential services, dining, and shopping in a neighborhood-focused environment. The center's strong 4.2-star rating from nearly 1,000 reviews reflects its role as a trusted destination for South Shore families and professionals seeking quality retailers in an accessible, community-oriented setting.
